prompts.title: 核心主张
prompts.prompt:
Generate exactly ONE complete presentation slide as a polished flat image, wide 16:9 composition. It is a Chinese client-facing brand concept presentation for Airtap, Direction A: Taps Back, based on a supplied proposal. This is an image concept for approval, NOT a website: no navigation, CTA buttons, browser chrome or slide editor, no device border around the full slide, no mockup of a slide in a room.
Shared art direction: warm ivory #F6F4ED background, forest-black #101510 typography, sage #98AB85 accents, dark forest #2E4641 for emphasis. Confident quiet editorial art direction with very generous space, strong asymmetrical layout, huge expressive elegant serif English words plus clean precise modern Simplified Chinese sans-serif. Warm real-life editorial photography when a scene is specified; photographic natural light, cream tactile 3D hand IP integrated at the digital task area. No tacky gradients, scrapbook tape, decorative stickers, cartoon people, stock business clipart, excessive panels or tiny unreadable paragraphs. Chinese typography must be perfectly legible. Do not invent any text beyond the exact copy supplied. Avoid full generic bullet-list layout. 80px equivalent safe margin at 1920 width; body around 32-40px equivalent, footer at least 20px. Keep all text inside canvas.
The character reference defines the IP strictly: a single self-contained cream-white soft matte hand silhouette, THREE rounded upright fingers and ONE side thumb = FOUR digits total, two black dot eyes and a curved smiling mouth on its palm, no arms, no legs, no body, no extra hands. Preserve this count even in different poses. It only handles digital interface information, never physically serves coffee or carries food.
The second reference when supplied is the approved visual baseline of THIS deck: keep its colors, font character, margins, footer and overall polish, while varying the page layout to suit the page's information. Do not copy its text or page content.
Product task/UI imagery is conceptual. Never imply payment, purchase, registration or booking has completed when only search/comparison/preparation is requested. No fabricated data claims, metrics, real shop logos, research quotes or unprovided product promises. Every scene/UI page needs the exact small label "创意示意".
PAGE 01 / Cover.
Make a strong editorial cover with about 60% typography and 40% character/art. Warm ivory canvas. Left upper tiny label "AIRTAP · 品牌概念提案". Huge forest black serif title in two lines "Taps" then "Back." occupying upper-left to center. Beneath this, carefully typeset two English lines at readable medium size: "Your apps make you tap." and "Airtap taps back." Lower-left Chinese line: "接手生活里反复发生的数字操作。"
Right half: one large beautiful cream hand IP, emerging from a sculptural ribbon of just three simplified headphone product information sheets transforming into one orderly comparison sheet. The actual character's original hand silhouette must remain visibly legible: do not add limbs. Each sheet repeats the same unbranded black headphones. Minimal small field labels in English "Model", "Total", "Delivery"; no prices or names. Soft tactile shadows, premium studio realism, quiet sage highlight. This is concept art of a digital workflow, not a physical buying scene. Keep all graphic art below/around text, not covering it. Footer left "Airtap / Taps Back"; footer right "01"; small "创意示意" beside the illustration. Emphasize sparse editorial elegance, not a collage.

prompts.title: 品牌收束
prompts.prompt:
Generate exactly ONE complete presentation slide as a polished flat image, wide 16:9 composition. It is a Chinese client-facing brand concept presentation for Airtap, Direction A: Taps Back, based on a supplied proposal. This is an image concept for approval, NOT a website: no navigation, CTA buttons, browser chrome or slide editor, no device border around the full slide, no mockup of a slide in a room.
Shared art direction: warm ivory #F6F4ED background, forest-black #101510 typography, sage #98AB85 accents, dark forest #2E4641 for emphasis. Confident quiet editorial art direction with very generous space, strong asymmetrical layout, huge expressive elegant serif English words plus clean precise modern Simplified Chinese sans-serif. Warm real-life editorial photography when a scene is specified; photographic natural light, cream tactile 3D hand IP integrated at the digital task area. No tacky gradients, scrapbook tape, decorative stickers, cartoon people, stock business clipart, excessive panels or tiny unreadable paragraphs. Chinese typography must be perfectly legible. Do not invent any text beyond the exact copy supplied. Avoid full generic bullet-list layout. 80px equivalent safe margin at 1920 width; body around 32-40px equivalent, footer at least 20px. Keep all text inside canvas.
The character reference defines the IP strictly: a single self-contained cream-white soft matte hand silhouette, THREE rounded upright fingers and ONE side thumb = FOUR digits total, two black dot eyes and a curved smiling mouth on its palm, no arms, no legs, no body, no extra hands. Preserve this count even in different poses. It only handles digital interface information, never physically serves coffee or carries food.
The second reference when supplied is the approved visual baseline of THIS deck: keep its colors, font character, margins, footer and overall polish, while varying the page layout to suit the page's information. Do not copy its text or page content.
Product task/UI imagery is conceptual. Never imply payment, purchase, registration or booking has completed when only search/comparison/preparation is requested. No fabricated data claims, metrics, real shop logos, research quotes or unprovided product promises. Every scene/UI page needs the exact small label "创意示意".
PAGE 10 / Brand close.
Create a memorable calm final brand poster slide with deep forest-black #101510 full background, ivory text and subtly sage accents. Very generous negative space. Upper-left or center-left has the two Chinese lines in large pristine sans typography:
"生活里的事照常做，"
"繁琐操作不必每次都由你来。"
Below them in huge elegant ivory serif font spanning most width:
"Airtap taps back."
At the far right lower quadrant one beautiful original cream-white hand IP faces forward with a warm smile, lit by subtle warm light, THREE fingers and ONE thumb, no arms/legs/body, partially tucked behind the large English word but don't cover text legibility. It is the same original shape, no work cards needed; character is a modest flourish not dominant over the closing message. No button or call to action, no sales pitch, no extra tagline, no thanks page.
Footer in muted ivory "Airtap / Taps Back", page "10".
